Priya (Product): Heads-up — large enterprise in EU wants a regional capacity commitment (reserved GPUs in eu-west) and hard latency SLOs. They said pricing depends on commitment level. Any red flags before we scope?
Dmitri (Infra): Sounds like Dedicated + regional pinning. Question: do they need isolated tenancy (no noisy neighbors) or just reserved capacity within shared pool?
Priya (Product): They asked for "data isolation" and SLA. Probably leaning Private/Dedicated. Asking for guidance on launch criteria and what we can promise for Q3.
Aisha (Eng-Platform): If they want data isolation + regional capacity, we need a private control plane or dedicated VPC in eu-west. That's a Q-level change: networking + KMS/keys. Can we meet SLA without on-prem?
Ben (Architecture): Two levers: capacity reservation (commit) and tenancy isolation (slice vs fully isolated). Tradeoffs:
• Slice (soft isolation): cheaper, faster to provision, lower tail latency guarantees.
• Full isolation (dedicated pool + network isolation): stronger guarantees, higher ops and hw cost.
Olivia (SRE): Also consider cross-region failover. If eu-west dies, do they accept failover to eu-central with degraded SLOs? That affects routing policy and customer contract.
Priya (Product): They explicitly said "zero region failover unless we pre-approve". So we need a plan for regional redundancy or a documented runbook for planned failovers.
Dmitri (Infra): Implementation notes:
```
- Reservation model: monthly commit tiers (low/med/high)
- Autoscale burst: allow short-term bursting to other regions for <5m with routing flag
- Control plane: per-tenant config flag: regional_pin=true
```
We need billing + quota enforcement hooks.
Aisha (Eng-Platform): For launch criteria propose:
1) infra: provisioned dedicated pool in eu-west (capacity tests pass)
2) networking: VPC peering & KMS integration verified
3) runtime: tenant pinning + prefetched KV cache working
4) SRE: chaos-tested regional outage and documented failover
5) Pricing: committed discount tiers and cancellation terms
Ben (Architecture): Measurement: define token-level P50/P95/P99 latency on a customer workload profile, not synthetic. Also define throughput per GPU ratio we guarantee.
Olivia (SRE): Ops playbook snippets: who to page, rollback to shared tier, throttles to protect other customers. We should add an automated flag to demote traffic to best-effort model variant.
Priya (Product): Customer asks about contract length — 12/24 months typical. They care about price cliffs if usage dips. Need legal to draft commit penalties.
Eve (Solutions Eng): From pre-sales: they will accept partial isolation if cost delta is >40% cheaper. They want an "isolation vs price" matrix to show options in the deal.
Ben (Architecture): Proposal: three SKUs
- Reserved-Slice: soft isolation, regional commit, cheaper
- Reserved-Dedicated: dedicated GPU pool per tenant, stronger SLA
- Private-OnPrem: customer-managed infra (high effort)
Each SKU has clear lat/throughput SLAs and failover rules.
Dmitri (Infra): Risks: capacity fragmentation if many medium commits. We need bin-packing heuristics + eviction policies. Also need marketplace of spare capacity.
Aisha (Eng-Platform): Operational cost estimate: provisioning a new dedicated pod ~2 weeks (infra + certs). Can we shorten with templated infra? Yes but requires infra automation sprint.
Priya (Product): Prioritization ask: if we create a Q3 initiative, what's the minimal uplift to meet first customer by end of Q3? Which teams and how many sprints?
Dmitri (Infra): Minimal path (MVP):
- 2 infra sprints: templated dedicated pool + quota enforcement
- 1 runtime sprint: tenant pinning + metrics
- 1 SRE sprint: runbook + chaos tests
That's ~6-8 weeks with dedicated resources.
Olivia (SRE): We also need a monitoring dashboard: token cost, pinned pool utilization, tail latency alerts. Otherwise oncall burden spikes.
Priya (Product): Decision needed: do we (A) go MVP reserved-slice first to close deal quickly, or (B) invest in reserved-dedicated for stronger SLA but longer lead time?
Ben (Architecture): My leaning: start with Reserved-Slice + explicit SLA riders, while parallel-track Dedicated infra as Q4 follow-up. That reduces time to revenue and validates demand.
Eve (Solutions Eng): Sales can take Reserved-Slice discounted offer with optional migration clause. Good compromise.
Aisha (Eng-Platform): Action items:
- Dmitri: cost/lead-time estimate for dedicated pod (by Tue)
- Ben: define SLA matrix and measurement plan (by Wed)
- Olivia: draft runbook and dashboard requirements (by Thu)
- Priya: coordinate legal on commitment terms (by Thu)

Priya (Product): If we agree, I'll update roadmap doc and ping sales for go/no-go with customer next week. :thumbsup:
Dmitri (Infra): Ack
Ben (Architecture): +1
Olivia (SRE): +1
Eve (Solutions Eng): Will prep pitch matrix
Priya (Product): tagging @here for visibility — please add any objections in thread.
